title: Three Ways Through
intro: Beyond the harbor lie three difficult passages. Each asks a different question: what can a small fleet achieve, which links matter most, and what plan holds while you are gone?
completion: Three passages are charted. Their answers disagree in useful ways, and your archive has room for each.
hints: Open and complete one dossier from each rule family.
Each dossier costs 100 Survey Notes once and remains replayable.
